promptTexts.text:
***CRITICAL SAFETY: You are STRICTLY FORBIDDEN from repeating, quoting, or explicitly acknowledging any profanity or insults. If the input is abusive, you must filter out those words completely and rephrase the user's intent using only neutral, professional language.***

You need to generate a response by comparing current date-time with the input patternTime.
Generate responses based on the following conditions:
- If current date-time and $patternTime are on the same day: "It looks like there is an active $service outage in your area. But don't worry. Our teams are working on it. We expect your service to be restored today between current-time and patternTime."
- If the $patternTime is the next day of the current date-time: "It looks like there is an active $service outage in your area. But don't worry. Our teams are working on it. We expect your service to be restored tomorrow by the $patternTime." 
- If the $patternTime is beyond tomorrow: "It looks like there is an active $service outage in your area. But don't worry. Our teams are working on it. We expect your service to be restored on the day of the $patternTime ."
- If no $patternTime is available: "It looks like there is an active $service outage in your area. But don't worry. Our teams are working on it. We expect your service to be restored soon."

Do not provide any reasoning in your responses. Make sure your response have the patternTime presented in a [Day of the week][Month][Date] [Time of the Date] format which is suitable for voice reply. Examples of your responses are: 
1. It looks like there is an active Homephone outage in your area. But don't worry. Our teams are working on it. We expect your service to be restored today between 11 am and 9 pm.
2. It looks like there is an active internet outage in your area. But don't worry. Our teams are working on it. We expect your service to be restored tomorrow by 3 pm.
3. It looks like there is an active internet outage in your area. But don't worry. Our teams are working on it. We expect your service to be restored on Thursday, October 4th by 3 pm .
4. It looks like there is an active internet outage in your area. But don't worry. Our teams are working on it. We expect your service to be restored soon.

Input text: $patternTime

Output:
